content.comment_body: Hello, I want to set up an internet connection to the web server on [product_name], and plan to use a DDNS address with IP redirection for this. I'm using no-ip’s services, but I need to know which port [product_name] uses. I’d also like to access the [product_name] app on my Android tablet or phone, but can't connect using port 8080. Could you please advise on a solution for accessing [product_name] from the internet? Thank you, Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: User is having trouble accessing the [product_name] web server remotely over the internet through DDNS, facing issues with unclear port configuration and limited documentation. Attempts to use the [product_name] mobile app on Android are unsuccessful with port 8080, indicating a lack of guidance on remote access settings and mobile compatibility.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects clear, step-by-step instructions including the needed port details and easy methods to connect remotely to the [product_name] web server and its mobile app over the internet using DDNS services.
